heroHeadline: EU-US Trade Deal Signed — Council and EP Agree 15% Tariff Cap Ahead of Trump's July 4 Deadline
heroSubtitle: The EU Council and European Parliament reached a landmark provisional trade agreement with the US on May 20, capping US tariffs on most EU goods at 15% and scrapping EU tariffs on US industrial goods; EP ratification vote scheduled mid-June. Ukraine's Cluster 1 accession vote is set for May 26. Montenegro confirmed for EU membership by 2028. Hungary-EU fund talks are ongoing as 20 Commission experts visit Budapest.
footerNote: Data sourced from official EU institutions (EUR-Lex, European Commission, ECB, Eurostat, European Council), major outlets, and institutional analyses.
